purpose: Per-recipe known-field sets for the WP6/#544 deterministic plan lint (template_field_unknown) and the S1-1 versioned template registry. Language-neutral: no JS, no imports, parse and use.

codeAnchors: extensions/ocuclaw/src/tools/glasses-ui-array-mapping.ts (bounded itemsFromPath resolution, substitution, and UTF-8 clamping)

notes.templatePathSyntax: Dot-separated. Array indices are bare numeric segments ('workflow_runs.0.status'), NOT bracket syntax. Bracket syntax belongs to recipe.jsonPath only.
notes.implicitPaths: Every recipe additionally exposes 'output' (the whole post-jsonPath value) and 'previous.<any path in this set>' (prior tick). A lint MUST accept both without listing them per recipe.
notes.matching: There is no recipe-id field on the wire today. Identify a spec's cookbook recipe by the 'match' object: method (default GET when absent) + urlHost + urlPathPrefix + jsonPath. All present keys must match; absent keys are wildcards.
notes.fieldSetClosed: true  = a template path outside knownFields is an error-grade finding. false = report at most a soft warning; the field set is legitimately extensible (query-driven or integration-driven).
notes.openPrefixes: Any template path under one of these prefixes is always acceptable regardless of fieldSetClosed.

lintCodes.template_field_unknown: WP6 heuristic this file feeds. The plan's original rule was 'http with jsonPath -> skip' because the post-extraction shape was unknowable. A spec matching a recipe below is no longer unknowable: apply the recipe's fieldSetClosed policy instead of skipping.

recipes.title: Open-Meteo current weather

cadence.rationale: The API's own 'current.interval' is 900 s; the data does not change faster. Keyless, but the cadence is a courtesy floor, not a rate limit.

consent.assertion: Display-only. No expiry-actuated consequence. Silence is never consent.

recipes.fieldSetOpenReason: The returned field set is exactly the caller's 'current=' query list. Requesting a field yields that field; a template path naming an unrequested field is still an authoring bug, but a lint cannot know the query's contents without parsing the URL.

knownFields.note: seconds; the vendor's own refresh rate
degC by default; units live in the sibling current_units object that $.current drops
WMO code; needs a lookup table, do not paint raw

verification.detail: GET api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?...&current=temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,wind_speed_10m,weather_code returned exactly these keys under 'current'.

lintExpectations.interval_vs_window: expected-and-correct-to-ignore: an ambient weather card is not meant to tick inside the listen window.

recipes.title: GitHub Actions latest workflow run

auth.note: Unauthenticated is the supported path (public repos, 60 req/hr/IP). There is NO secret-reference mechanism in the recipe path: headers pass through verbatim, no env expansion exists. An authenticated variant means a literal token in a tool call and is operator-gated, never agent-initiated.
auth.lintHint: A recipe matching this entry that carries an Authorization/x-api-key header is a finding, not a normal recipe.

cadence.rationale: Unauthenticated api.github.com allows 60 req/hr/IP. 120000 ms = 30/hr, half the budget. 60000 ms is exactly the limit and nothing honors Retry-After for http recipes at HEAD.

consent.assertion: Display-only. No expiry-actuated consequence. Silence is never consent.

knownFields.note: workflow name; truncate for the HUD
40 chars; truncate:7 for a short sha
too long for a HUD line

recipes.emptyResultBehavior: A branch with no runs makes $.workflow_runs[0] undefined. The tick still counts as a SUCCESS and every path renders empty, so user-visible fields need a 'default:' filter rather than relying on a failure signal.

verification.detail: GET api.github.com/repos/cli/cli/actions/runs?per_page=1 returned a workflow_runs[0] object carrying every path listed here.

lintExpectations.template_field_unknown: enforce — this set is closed and stable.
lintExpectations.nullable_without_default: conclusion without a 'default:' filter renders empty for the whole duration of a running build.

auth.note: Public repositories only. The existing no-literal-token rule is unchanged.

cadence.rationale: Unauthenticated api.github.com allows 60 requests/hour/IP; 120000 ms uses half that budget.

consent.assertion: Display-only list replacement. No expiry- or tick-actuated consequence. Silence is never consent.

limits.overflow: drop trailing rows deterministically and emit named clamp diagnostics
limits.pagination: not supported; load-more requires a separate explicit wearer turn

verification.detail: The registered element fields are the closed workflow-run fields already verified by github_actions_latest_run@1.

lintExpectations.template_field_unknown: enforce against the selected array mapping's closed element field set.

recipes.title: Home Assistant single entity state
recipes.requiresAllowHost: <the operator's PUBLIC Home Assistant hostname, e.g. .ui.nabu.casa>

worksWithinGuard: https://<instance>.ui.nabu.casa (Nabu Casa Cloud: public DNS, public IP)
an existing operator-run public reverse proxy
confirmGated: any private-range or loopback exception to the SSRF guard
adding a private or .local hostname to httpAllowHosts (which would not work anyway: the allowlist is an additional gate, not an override of the guard)
exposing a LAN-only Home Assistant to the internet (port forward, tunnel, new proxy, new subscription)
any local-relay or side-channel scheme whose purpose is to get private-network data past the guard
ssrf.confirmGateRule: Every item under confirmGated is a network-exposure change and requires Matty's explicit CONFIRM before anyone builds it. No agent may take one as a step, and none may be actuated and reported afterwards.

auth.note: HA's REST API requires a long-lived access token. The same no-secret-reference gap as GitHub applies unchanged: the token would be a literal in a tool call. Operator decision only.

cadence.rationale: An HA sensor card is an ambient glance and HA state is push-updated internally; polling faster only loads the operator's own box.

consent.assertion: Read-only state fetch. POST /api/services/... is schema-legal but MUST NOT appear in a refresh recipe: a refresh fires on a timer, and a timer firing is not consent. Actuation belongs to an explicit tap outcome with staleAfterMs set, handled in the agent's turn.
consent.lintHint: An http recipe whose method is POST and whose urlPathPrefix is /api/services/ is an actuation-on-a-timer finding, error grade.

recipes.fieldSetOpenReason: The top level is closed, but 'attributes' is integration-defined and varies per entity. An unrecognized attributes.* path must not be reported as an error.

knownFields.note: ALWAYS a string, even for numeric sensors; 'unavailable' and 'unknown' are legal values
present on most entities, not guaranteed

verification.detail: NOT verified against a live instance — no Home Assistant was reachable from the authoring session. Field names are HA's documented REST state shape. Re-check against the operator's instance with one manual request before trusting a template.

lintExpectations.template_field_unknown: enforce for top-level paths; always accept anything under the 'attributes.' open prefix.
